tracemaker.cli_verified_from: src/app/main.cpp at the pinned commit (route subcommand options)
tracemaker.learned_state: --no-kb: the cross-run knowledge base is neither read nor written
tracemaker.determinism_note: upstream claims output is identical at any --threads under --work; not verified by this protocol

build_environment.compiler: g++ 13 (the presets' g++-15 is not needed)
build_environment.system_packages: Boost, Eigen3, SQLite3 and zstd development packages from the host (versions not recorded)
build_environment.scratch_prefix_recipe: clone each at the tag, cmake -S <src> -B <src>/b -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/tmp/fleet/prefix && cmake --install <src>/b; then configure TraceMaker with -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=/tmp/fleet/prefix. Nothing is installed on the host.

fastroute.interchange: DSN from kicad_tools.export.dsn.KiCadToDSNExporter; SES merged back with kicad_tools.export.ses.SESToKiCadImporter into the normalized input
fastroute.partial_output_note: fastroute rewrites the .ses with the best board so far, so a partial session exists at timeout; the row stays `timeout`

kct.requires: C++ backend built in the active worktree (`uv run kct build-native`); otherwise the row is tool-failure/native-backend

stripping_policy.name: strip-tracks-and-vias
stripping_policy.scope: top-level children of (kicad_pcb ...) only; nested forms such as arcs in zone outlines are untouched
preserves: footprints and pads (placement, rotation, side, pad nets)
zones (keepout and copper; fills are recomputed by the referee)
stripping_policy.applies_to: every included board identically; fixed-placement baseline only (preserved-copper, fanout and length-tuning variants are separate, not mixed into baseline rows)
